message.content:
The cover of Tempo magazine, dated "13-19 MEI 2019," features an illustration of a man with a high forehead and a serious expression. He is crouched on the ground, wearing a light grey long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. He holds a wooden mallet in his right hand and a large metal nail in his left, positioned over a small, four-legged wooden stool. The stool rests on the ground before him, holding a metal measuring tape and an L-shaped square ruler.

Surrounding the man are numerous wooden chairs with curved backs, arranged in rows that extend toward the top of the frame. Most chairs are light brown, while some in the background appear blue and red. On one chair to the man's right sits a small metal can containing a paintbrush.

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large white capital letters across the upper third of the image. The headline at the bottom reads "SIAP-SIAP GANTI KABINET" in bold black text, followed by smaller text starting with "PARTAI KOALISI BERADU LINCAH..." Other legible phrases include "CALON TUNGGAL DEPUTI GUBERNUR SENIOR BI" and "INFORMAN POLISI DALAM PERKARA VANESSA ANGEL" at the top. A barcode is in the lower-right corner.
